about: Draws one set against another, a mark at every crossing.
caption: Service health by region

gap.about: Three services with APAC never run. A crossing nobody measured draws its own mark rather than a blank, and it counts as unknown in the rollup, which outranks both a pass and a crossing that does not apply. Read the Worst column against the marks beside it: auth passed everywhere it ran and still closes as unknown, and billing closes as down because down outranks unknown. Left blank, a region nobody checked would read as a region with nothing wrong.
gap.title: A gap outranks a pass

picking.about: Given a handler, every crossing becomes a button and the grid takes a tab stop per crossing. Without one nothing in the grid is pressable and nothing in it is a tab stop, and a hover lights the crossing's row and its column instead. A crossing nobody measured is a button as well, because that is the pair somebody wants to go and measure. The hover stays a quiet neutral rather than the accent: the mark's own colour is the data, and a strong fill under it destroys what the crossing is saying. Press the crossing that is already picked to clear it: the grid marks no crossing as picked, so the line under it is the only answer, and pressing one twice wrote the same line twice.
picking.title: Picking a crossing

plain.about: The rows drawn straight through rather than gathered, and a grid with no rows at all. Sections are drawn where every row states one, so a list where only some do is drawn as one body rather than under a heading half of it does not belong to.
plain.title: Without sections

size.about: Every step the grid is read at. A matrix is scanned rather than read, so the step decides how many rows fit on one screen.
size.title: Sizes
